text.text_excerpt: I work in New Orleans East, which doesn't really add to the narrative, but the food options are slim, we only get 30 minutes for lunch, blah blah blah. So, when we got an email and there were flyers saying that various food trucks would be coming out this week, I was excited as Diva Dawg was listed as being one that came out to us. ALL OF THE WAY out to us! I had heard many good things about this food truck. You get in line for the window, look at the menu and order. They do have a menu board, and you can pay with a card by square. You get a laminated slip of paper that has a famous persons name on it as your order placer instead of a number or them asking for your name. The first day, I ...

I was surprised to see that Diva Dawg didn't have a listing. They've been serving breakfast and lunch near my work for a couple of months. They make all their own sausages for their dogs, including the veggie dog with veggie chili that I tried today. My coworker got the red bean dog with fried chicken nuggets on top! That seems to be their signature item. The veggie dog was really tasty (with a red bean base); I advise adding creole mustard for some zing. Love that they accept text message orders if you're short on time. Super friendly staff and quick turnaround. Follow them on Instagram, FB or twitter to find them around the city.

Thank you sooo much for servicing USDA in the East. Our lunch selections are extremely limited and often substandard. The Veggie Dog is absolutely amazing! My coworkers were looking for the truck today and in the words of a fellow co worker if Diva Dawg isn't out there I'm not going.
